import.title: Import items from a spreadsheet
import.step1: Download the template — it has a column for each of your menu languages.
import.step2: Fill in one item per row in Excel or Google Sheets. New categories are created automatically.
import.step3: Save it as CSV (UTF-8) and upload it here.
import.note: Only the {lang} category, name and price are required. Rows starting with # are ignored. Importing adds new items; it doesn't change existing ones.
import.errors: Rows that need fixing (they will be skipped): {count}
import.done: Import finished. Items imported: {items} · New categories: {categories}
import.failed: Items that couldn't be saved: {count} (lines {lines}). Check them and import again.
import.noRows: No items found in this file.
import.missingColumns: This file is missing required columns: {columns}. Download the template and start from it.
import.tooMany: This file has more than {max} items. Split it into smaller files.
import.readError: Couldn't read this file. Save it as “CSV UTF-8” and try again.
import.runError: The import stopped because of an error. Items imported so far were saved.
